Found 39 items in registries @liquefy-ui:

Showing items 1-39 of 39:

- liquefy-ui (registry:style) - Design tokens, the glass stylesheet and the Tailwind v4 bridge. Every other item depends on this. Import the installed stylesheet before Tailwind so utilities win over component styles. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- glass-card (registry:ui) - A content card with eyebrow, title, description, body and footer slots on the liquid surface. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- glass-dock (registry:ui) - A macOS-style dock: a glass rail of icon buttons that magnify under the pointer. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- internal-glyphs (registry:lib) - The small inline SVG glyphs the components draw for chevrons, checks and status icons. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-accordion (registry:ui) - Stacked disclosure panels with real headings and a height-measured open animation. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-alert (registry:ui) - An inline status message in four severities, with an optional dismiss button. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-avatar (registry:ui) - A circular avatar with image, initials and status dot, plus an overlapping group. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-badge (registry:ui) - A small count or status pill for hanging off icons and labels. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-breadcrumbs (registry:ui) - A trail of links with glyph separators and a current-page marker. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-button (registry:ui) - The primary action control: WebGL rim light, jelly press spring and a loading state. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-checkbox (registry:ui) - A checkbox with a springy tick, indeterminate state and label support. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-chip (registry:ui) - A compact tag that can be selected, tinted and dismissed. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-date-picker (registry:ui) - A calendar popover on a field trigger: a roving-tabindex month grid and ISO values. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-dialog (registry:ui) - A modal on Base UI: trapped focus, inert background and wired-up title and description. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-divider (registry:ui) - A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, with optional inline content. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-drawer (registry:ui) - A side panel that slides from the left, right or bottom edge, on Base UI Dialog. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-glass (registry:ui) - The bare material with its optics as props: refraction, frost, veil and bezel. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-icon-button (registry:ui) - A square icon-only button that takes its accessible name from a label prop. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-list (registry:ui) - A glass list with items, descriptions, leading icons, trailing slots and subheaders. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-menu (registry:ui) - A dropdown action menu on Base UI: arrow keys, typeahead and collision-aware placement. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-pagination (registry:ui) - A page strip with ellipsis truncation and previous/next controls. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-progress (registry:ui) - A determinate progress bar and an indeterminate spinner sharing one accent. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-radio (registry:ui) - A radio group with a springy dot and keyboard-driven selection. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-rating (registry:ui) - A star rating that reads and writes a numeric value. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-segmented (registry:ui) - A segmented control whose glass indicator slides between options. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-select (registry:ui) - A listbox dropdown on Base UI: typeahead, focus return and a glass popover. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-skeleton (registry:ui) - A shimmering placeholder block for content that has not arrived. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-slider (registry:ui) - A range input with a luminous track and a dimensional thumb. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-surface (registry:ui) - The base material every glass component is built on: rim light, refraction and springs. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-switch (registry:ui) - A toggle whose thumb squashes as it travels. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-table (registry:ui) - A composable data table on a glass container, with row hover and selection. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-tabs (registry:ui) - Composable tabs on Base UI, with a glowing underline that springs between them. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-text-field (registry:ui) - A single-line text input with label, hint and invalid state. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-textarea (registry:ui) - A multi-line text input that keeps the field styling of LiquidTextField. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-toast (registry:ui) - A toast provider and a useLiquidToast hook for transient messages. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- liquid-tooltip (registry:ui) - A glass bubble on hover and focus, positioned by Base UI so it stays on screen. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- provider (registry:lib) - LiquefyProvider and the config hooks every component reads its tokens from. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- styles-prop (registry:lib) - The `styles` prop engine: shorthands, token references, breakpoints and state selectors. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-liquid-glass (registry:hook) - The hook that wires an element to the WebGL renderer and the motion springs. [@liquefy-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
